::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Hubballi startup incubated at KLE Technological University's CTIE (founding year given as both 2018 and 2019 on its own site). Has taped out two test chips in its MATOMAC line of M2M/automation ICs; about 30 staff (Dec 2023).
:::

## What does this firm design?

MATOMAC SoC/ASIC chipsets for machine-to-machine automation, and embedded IoT products (Jalvidha, e-cods).

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 3/5:** M2M automation and IoT SoC/ASIC chipsets.
- **IP ownership 3/5:** Own MATOMAC chipset line.
- **Design completeness 3/5:** Taped out two MATOMAC test chips.
- **Market readiness 2/5:** Sells embedded IoT products; no customers reported for its own chips.
